status: SEED - corrected against the draft translations in TEAM_TASK_BREAKDOWN.md, which contained several errors
corrections_log: fever: 'Moto' (heat) -> 'homa' (fever). 'Moto' is the wrong word for a fever.
diarrhoea: 'Kuvimba' (swelling) -> 'kuhara'. The draft translation described swelling, not diarrhoea.
cough: 'Kikohozi' retained (correct). 'chest pain': standardised to 'maumivu ya kifua'.
All entries still require review by a native Swahili-speaking clinician before pilot use.

YELLOW.label_en: URGENT - Go to the clinic today

GREEN.label_en: ROUTINE - You can manage this at home

instructions.do_not_wait: Usisubiri. Hali hii ni ya dharura.
instructions.home_care: Jipatie mapumziko nyumbani na ufuatilie dalili zako.
instructions.take_paracetamol: Kunywa paracetamol kwa homa na maumivu.
instructions.take_medicine_as_prescribed: Kunywa dawa zako kila siku kama ulivyoelekezwa.
instructions.keep_feet_clean: Safisha na uangalie miguu yako kila siku.
instructions.come_back_if_worse: Rudi kliniki ikiwa dalili zinaendelea au zinazidi.
instructions.bring_card: Leta kadi yako ya SHA au kitambulisho.

cost.free_phf: Huduma hii ni bure kwa kadi ya SHA kwenye kituo cha afya.
cost.covered_eccif: Dharura hii inalipwa kikamilifu na SHA (ECCIF).
cost.sha_contribution: Mchango wa SHA ni asilimia 2.75 ya mapato, kiwango cha chini cha KES 300 kwa mwezi.

reassurance.not_a_diagnosis: Huu ni mwongozo tu, si utambuzi wa ugonjwa. Daktari atakuchunguza.
reassurance.not_a_replacement: Mfumo huu unasaidia tu. Hauwachukui nafasi ya muuguzi au daktari.
